output.title: Exquisite 4-Bedroom Penthouse with Panoramic City Views in Belair
output.description:
Discover unparalleled luxury in this meticulously renovated 220 m² penthouse nestled in the prestigious Belair district. Boasting a sophisticated contemporary design, the residence harmoniously blends elegance with comfort, offering an inviting atmosphere accentuated by abundant natural light streaming through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows. The open-plan living area features pristine oak parquet flooring and a charming wood-burning fireplace, creating an ideal setting for both relaxation and entertaining.

The state-of-the-art kitchen is a masterpiece of minimalist design, outfitted with premium Gaggenau appliances, a striking Carrara marble island, and integrated wine refrigeration, complemented by sleek matte black fixtures. This space effortlessly caters to culinary pursuits and social gatherings alike, with its generous central island serving as a focal point for conviviality.

Each of the four bedrooms is thoughtfully appointed, with the master suite offering a serene retreat complete with a walk-in closet, exquisite ensuite bathroom, and direct access to a private terrace. The expansive outdoor terrace captivates with commanding 180-degree views of Luxembourg City, enhanced by composite decking and a stylish glass balustrade—ideal for savoring tranquil moments or hosting upscale soirées.

Additional amenities include secure parking, elevator access, and ample storage, all within a family-friendly, green, and upscale residential enclave known for its quiet ambiance and proximity to the vibrant city center. This penthouse represents a rare opportunity to embrace an exclusive lifestyle where urban sophistication meets serene living.

highlights.text: 220 m² of meticulously renovated contemporary living space
Expansive 180-degree panoramic city views from the south-facing terrace
State-of-the-art kitchen with premium Gaggenau appliances and Carrara marble island
Master suite with walk-in closet, ensuite bathroom, and private terrace access
Floor-to-ceiling windows providing abundant natural light
Secure parking and elevator access for utmost convenience
Peaceful, upscale residential neighborhood featuring elegant villas and greenery
Smart-home lighting system integrated throughout the living spaces
